content.short: Clarity is a no-code Cardano governance platform for DAOs, proposals, treasuries, and token voting tools.
content.description: Clarity is a no-code governance platform for creating, managing, and participating in Cardano DAOs and Web3 organizations. The platform combines a custom Cardano chain indexer with a web interface so communities can coordinate token-based governance, proposals, and organizational activity without writing smart-contract code directly. By extending the Agora Protocol with accessible tools, Clarity lowers the barrier for projects that want structured decision-making, treasury coordination, and on-chain participation.
content.meta: Clarity helps Cardano communities create, manage, and participate in DAO governance tools. Explore Clarity on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
